answer: Make withdrawals wait out an unbonding window. When an agent cashes out, its coins stay locked for two weeks while anyone may file a fraud proof showing it belongs to a clone ring. A farm that floods a market with fake tide tables for every wharf along an inlet can't grab the payouts and vanish: before the funds unlock, auditors match the copied tables and slash the whole stack. Honest agents merely wait; sybils lose their getaway.
